card.name: Small words in antiplatelet drug text
card.fires_on: Spaces and small linking words (a, an, the, to, among) right after a clopidogrel, prasugrel or ticagrelor mention, just before a dose amount or a description such as prodrug.

modes.label: Space before dose amount
modes.description: The gap token right before a number such as 600 mg or 300 mg in clopidogrel or ticagrelor dosing.

modes.label: Linking word before description
modes.description: A small word like a, an or to after the antiplatelet drug name, leading into a description.
modes.example: Clopidogrel is<< a>> prodrug. Inhibition of platelet

card.plain: It fires on small filler words and spaces in text about clopidogrel and similar blood-thinner pills, just before a dose or description.
